Useful Resources

  • ArchWiki | ArchWiki - Wine

Although obviously focused around the Arch ecosystem, the Arch Wiki nevertheless contains many in depth guides which can be applied to resolving issues for other distributions. If you get stuck on a particular Wine, or even Linux related issue, I'd strongly recommend checking out the Arch Wiki.

  • WineHQ | WineHQ - Wiki | WineHQ - AppDB

WineHQ should be your go-to hub for developments surrounding the Wine Project. The Wiki provides many useful guides around using and troubleshooting Wine, and the AppDB contains a database of configuration reports on various games and windows application. It is always advisable to check here first, to see if someone else has already got a game you're wanting to play, working.

  • Forums - Arch Forums | Solus Forums | Ubuntu Forums

Even though it is #currentyear, Forums are still a relevant and important source of information when it comes to tackling Linux and Wine related issues. Be forewarned, however, that these forums will only deal with the distribution they were created for. Do not go to the Arch forums looking for support to an issue you encountered on Ubuntu, and always, always, read the manual and attempt to undertake some level of troubleshooting yourself, before seeking assistance, to avoid the standard RTFM greeting.
